_note: Necessary conditions for an agent high-level design (design documents for an agent). Code checks each one on agent_hld.md after every build; the agent HLD is workable only when all are met, except a "severity": "warn" one (a heuristic check: Audit weighs it, it never blocks) and Audit accepts. "check" names the code check in j2.condition_met().

conditions.text: All nine sections are present and not empty
Steps have unique sequential ids (S1, S2, ...)
Components have unique sequential ids (C1, C2, ...)
Every agent PRD requirement appears in a component
conditions.label: agent PRD requirements

conditions.text: No invented facts: every number, email and proper name comes from the charter, the Requester's answers or the agent PRD, or sits in an Assumption: line
